purpose: Publish the two verifier identities the Control Plane relies on, so that a real Signed Task and a real Signed Evidence record can be raised from OBSERVED to PROVEN by an independent reader instead of being taken on trust.

publication.publication_rule: Only public key material is published. Private keys stay on their hosts, are never committed, never copied into a projection and never transmitted. A published public key is a verification aid, not an authority: it cannot sign, cannot publish a Task and cannot authorize an operation.

retrieval.method: read-only file read over the Alibaba Cloud Workbench tunnel; no write, no service change, no signing, no deployment
retrieval.verified_by: independent local recomputation of both fingerprint forms from the retrieved bytes

identities.why_the_binding_is_two_sided: The Hong Kong agent verifies incoming Tasks with its own copy at /etc/go-hk-agent/keys/task-verify.pub. The archived fingerprint of that file equals the fingerprint published here, so the signer and the verifier provably hold the same identity.

retrieval.method: read-only file read of the Command Center verifier copy over the Alibaba Cloud Workbench tunnel; no write, no service change, no signing, no deployment
retrieval.verified_by: independent local recomputation of both fingerprint forms from the retrieved bytes
retrieval.note: The Hong Kong host was not reachable from this workstation at retrieval time (two attempts, connection timeout). The signer-side copy at /etc/go-hk-agent/keys/evidence-signing.pub was therefore not re-read live; it is covered by the committed 2026-09-11 audit fingerprint, with which this key agrees.

identities.why_the_binding_is_two_sided: The key published here is the exact key the Hong Kong host's own audit recorded for the evidence signer, so a published verifier and the signing host provably share one identity. The live signer-side read is NOT_PERFORMED and is reported as such rather than assumed.

separation_evidence.statement: The two identities are different keys. A Task cannot validate against the evidence key and Evidence cannot validate against the task key. If a reader is handed one key for both roles the projection records an identity collision and refuses every PROVEN claim.

rotation.rule: A rotation publishes a new identity entry with a new identity_id and a new fingerprint, and supersedes the old one. An identity is never silently replaced in place, and a superseded fingerprint is never deleted while Evidence carrying it still exists.

what_this_contract_does_not_do: It does not create, publish or approve a Task.
It does not call the Narrow Executor or reach Hong Kong.
It does not evaluate deploy or rollback readiness.
